module.name: sample_ctrl
module.description:
Sampler controller.

Runs one capture window per start request: it arms, enables the capture
path for RUN_CYCLES clock cycles (or until the FIFO overflows), then reports
done and waits for the request to be withdrawn before it can run again.

State sequence: IDLE -> ARMED -> RUN -> DONE -> IDLE.

generics.name: RUN_CYCLES
generics.description: Length of the capture window in clock cycles.

ports.name: rst
ports.description: Synchronous active-high reset. Returns the FSM to IDLE.

ports.name: start
ports.description: Start request; held high until the capture is done.

ports.name: overflow
ports.description: A sample was lost; ends the window early.

ports.name: capture_en
ports.description: High while samples should be captured.

ports.name: busy
ports.description: High from arming until the request is withdrawn.

ports.name: state_code
ports.description: Current state, 0 IDLE, 1 ARMED, 2 RUN, 3 DONE.

processes.label: p_state_reg
processes.description:
p_state_reg: Clocked state register and window counter.
Synchronous reset returns the state to IDLE and clears the counter.

processes.label: p_next_state
processes.description:
p_next_state: Combinational next-state logic.
A start request arms the controller; the window ends after RUN_CYCLES
cycles or on overflow; DONE is left when the request is withdrawn.

mermaid.caption: Controller states
mermaid.source:
stateDiagram-v2
  [*] --> IDLE
  IDLE --> ARMED: start
  ARMED --> RUN
  RUN --> DONE: window over or overflow
  DONE --> IDLE: start withdrawn

processes.label: p_outputs
processes.description:
p_outputs: Combinational Moore output decode.
Capture is enabled in RUN only; busy covers everything but IDLE.
